title: Sync fixes — four screen changes to keep or revert

steps.path: Settings → Backup & Sync, when sync has failed
steps.headline: The Try again button now sits on the right side of the sync box.
steps.changed: The Try again and Connect GitHub buttons moved from under the message on the left to the right edge, under the on/off switch.
steps.notice: The buttons line up with the switch above them instead of with the red message text.
steps.risk: A long message and the buttons are now farther apart, so your eye travels across the box.

steps.headline: Pressing Try again now shows Syncing… until the attempt really finishes.
steps.changed: Before, the box kept saying Couldn't sync while the retry ran, so the button looked broken. Now it switches to Syncing… and stays there until the sync ends.
steps.notice: You see the retry happen. If it fails again, the box turns red again with the new error; if it works, it turns green.
steps.risk: On a slow connection or a big upload, Syncing… can stay up for several minutes.

steps.path: Settings → Backup & Sync, when a conversation is too big to sync
steps.headline: A new orange line tells you which conversations are too big to sync.
steps.changed: Conversations over 50 MB used to be skipped with no message anywhere. Now the box names them and says they stay on this device.
steps.notice: Click the orange line to see the conversation names. The line goes away if a file is deleted or shrinks back under the limit.
steps.risk: Your other devices still won't get new messages in those conversations; this only makes that visible.

steps.headline: The Settings gear turns red when GitHub sync is failing.
steps.changed: The red dot used to appear only for the older Google Drive and iCloud backups. It now also appears when your main GitHub sync fails.
steps.notice: You find out sync is broken without opening Settings. The dot clears once a sync succeeds.
steps.risk: A one-off sync error keeps the dot on until the next successful sync, usually within 2 minutes.
